Elena Park: Quick heads-up — All‑hands tomorrow 11:00am PT in the main room. Short agenda below; please drop any questions here so we can prioritize them for the Q&A. :loudspeaker:

Elena Park: Agenda: 1) Exec update & company priorities; 2) Dedicated + Private rollout timeline; 3) Policy update (data retention & logs); 4) Ops/SLOs + incident review; 5) Q&A.

Ashok Rao: Thanks — can you clarify the policy item? retention change for hosted customers?

Elena Park: Short answer: yes, default hosted logs retention will move from 30 -> 7 days for new accounts to reduce unit costs and compliance surface. Existing customers won't be changed without explicit notice/contract. We'll publish a FAQ + migration options.

Marcus Li: Will Dedicated customers be affected or auto-migrated? Need to prep support docs.

Elena Park: No auto-migration for Dedicated. We'll provide a migration guide and a recommended config. Timeline + doc by next Wed.

Sophia Nguyen: Also expect billing questions — changes to default retention could affect unit cost. Can we surface expected cost delta for common usage patterns?

Product Bot: Slides and the raw agenda uploaded: https://docs.internal/redwood/allhands/1837654321/agenda.pdf

Product Bot: Recording link will be posted here after the meeting: https://drive.internal/redwood/recordings/1837654321 (will update with final upload)

Elena Park: Action items so far: 1) Retention FAQ & customer comms — @Ashok Rao; 2) Dedicated migration guide — @Marcus Li; 3) Billing impact summary (examples) — @Sophia Nguyen. I'll collect top thread Qs and send to execs for the live Q&A.

Ashok Rao: I'll draft the FAQ + kernel of the customer email today, will ping for review.

Marcus Li: Starting the migration doc outline now; will sync with infra for exact steps.

Sophia Nguyen: I'll pull 3 cost scenarios (low/medium/high) and a couple of quick slide visuals.

Elena Park: Thanks team. Please add any questions you want called out in the meeting. If it's sensitive, DM me and I'll include anonymously. :eyes:
